content: Runae kapoekung thung hoi hlout nahanlah ratoumnae
Kathutkung: Devit, Devit teh Gath kho vah, Filistin kut dawk a pha nah a sak e la

content.text: Oe Cathut, kai na pahren haw.
Taminaw ni padoun hanelah hnintangkuem na tuk teh,
na rektap awh.
Ka tarannaw ni hnintangkuem na kaven awh.
Oe Lathueng Poung, na ka tarannaw teh apap poung.
Ka lung a puen toteh,
nang na kâuep han.
Cathut dawk (a lawk ka pholen han),
Cathut ka kâuep dawkvah, taki han awm hoeh.
Tami ni kai dawk bangmouh a sak thai han.
Ahnimouh teh kaie lawk hah hnintangkuem
alouklah a pouk awh.
Kai dawk kahawihoehe pouknae dueng doeh a pouk awh.
Kai thei hanelah a kâcai awh teh,
cungtalah a kamkhueng awh teh,
ka khokhnuk hah mitnout a ta awh.
Ahnimouh teh a payonnae dawk hoi a hlout awh han namaw.
Oe Cathut, na lungkhuek nateh, ahnimanaw hah koung pâlei haw.
Ka kâvanae hah na touk teh,
tuium dawk ka mitphi hah na ta.
Na cauk dawk ao nahoehmaw.
Nang koe ka hram toteh, ka tarannaw koung a yawng awh han.
Hetheh ka panue.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, Cathut teh kaie doeh.
Cathut dawk (a lawk hah ka pholen han),
BAWIPA dawk (a lawk hah ka pholen han).
Cathut ka kâuep dawkvah, ka taket mahoeh.
Tami ni kai dawk bangmouh a sak thai han.
Oe Cathut, nang koe ka lawkkamnae ni na katek teh,
nang koevah, pholennae ka dei han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka hringnae heh duenae thung hoi na rungngang.
Kahringnaw e angnae rahim vah,
Cathut hmalah ka pai thai na han,
ka khok kamthui hoeh nahan,
na rungngang toe nahoehmaw.
